name: Bollullos de la Mitación (Spain)
description: Vertically divided green and white with the green hoist third, charged with the crowned municipal arms of Bollullos de la Mitación (a tree on white and a tower on green).
history: Municipal flag of Bollullos de la Mitación; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Bollullos de la Mitación arms — tree on white and tower on green
cap of the crown of the arms
